verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly promise no silent updates and a manual `npx skills update` pull model, plus a copy mode where files become plain, editable, owned files in the repo — both giving a lead control over timing. However there is no evidence of pinning to a specific version, a lockfile, or changelog/diff review before pulling updates, so version control is coarse (all-or-nothing update command) rather than granular pinning. Missing for 10: explicit version pinning mechanism, lockfile support, changelog/diff preview before update.
